# BuildCost GH
> Get accurate construction cost estimates for building projects in Ghana. Built for Ghanaians and the global African diaspora.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://buildcostgh.com)
- [Construction Cost Calculator](https://buildcostgh.com/calculator) — Free instant cost estimates
- [Pricing](https://buildcostgh.com/pricing) — Reports from $29, unlimited from $19/mo
- [Services](https://buildcostgh.com/services) — Cost reports, contractor matching, project monitoring
- [How It Works](https://buildcostgh.com/how-it-works) — 4-step process explained
- [Contractors](https://buildcostgh.com/contractors) — Verified contractors across all 16 regions
- [Blog](https://buildcostgh.com/blog) — Ghana construction guides and cost breakdowns
- [About](https://buildcostgh.com/about)
- [Contact](https://buildcostgh.com/contact)
- [Authors](https://buildcostgh.com/authors)
